title: Promote current settings and restore plate edge outlines

request.text:
поставь пользовательские настройки дефолтными

мне бы хотелось чтобы линии на границах блоков очерчивали также грани, они потерялись на каком-то этапе

decision: Generate canonical source defaults from the supplied Toolcraft settings JSON v3, and add grid-strength-controlled continuous outlines at the top and bottom side-wall edges of every separated lower plate plus the bottom edge of the upper mountain block.
result: The supplied settings are canonical source defaults, every separated block edge has continuous grid-controlled side-wall ink, six focused unit checks passed, and the two protected browser scenarios passed.
checks: Focused product and plate unit tests
Plate-gap browser acceptance with shader edge-ink proof
risks: Existing browser workspaces retain precedence until Reset controls; the live deliverable is reset to the new source defaults.
